title: Regularity in a degree-p fraction-field step
statement: Let A be a complete regular local domain with fraction field K, and C a complete Noetherian local, regular A-algebra whose local structure map is formally smooth adically [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Let L/K be finite purely inseparable, K of prime characteristic p, and M intermediate with [L:M] = p. Use compatible A-actions. If M tensor_A C [def-weil-module-base-change] is regular [def-weil-regular-scheme], then L tensor_A C is regular.

source.place: Proposition Tag 07PM, proof of (4) => (1), coefficient reduction and final two paragraphs; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07PM

proof.text: Obtain f in R = M tensor_A C, a derivation D with D(f) a unit, and an equivalence R[z]/(z^p-f) to L tensor_A C from the degree-p construction.

Install the assumed regularity of R. Since p is prime, 1 <= p. Apply degree-p-extension-regular with exponent p and the unit derivative, then transport regularity through the supplied ring equivalence.
